scope: Synthetic n/u/m following-neighbor experiment; not historical-hand or S3 admission
preparation_authorization: Okay let's prepare CURRICULUM-006—how neighboring letters change their strokes.
canonical_layers: Four primitives, three gestures, fixed action, and n/u/m recipes remain byte-frozen; new contract required for derived occurrence geometry

proposed_variant_grid.horizontal_anchor: Canonical letter entry x before placement
proposed_variant_grid.geometry_definition: Apply x'=x_entry+s*(x-x_entry), y'=y to every control point in the composed letter; transform and renormalize tangents. Physical nib is never stretched.

spacing_only.advance_delta: selected from the same grid and training judgments

partitions.held_out_policy: Only the six triples are context-composition-disjoint holdouts; previously reviewed pairs are not pristine unseen samples

measurement.local_windows: Freeze per-occurrence union over all allowed variants and placement combinations plus 0.8 mm before scoring
measurement.old_regression_mode: Exact known base fixtures in original frame only

learning.target_source: Owner ranks bounded TRAINING previews; these are subjective preference labels, not independent historical exemplar images
learning.objective: Minimize frozen preference disagreement on six training rule cells; separable enumeration, not a whole-word table
learning.development_use: Safety and reading check only; no retuning; failure withholds sealed test
learning.held_out_access: After one selected table and development outcome are frozen

proposed_budget.accounting: All preview/reference/mask/presentation calls must be journaled. Pre-fit human-review preview calls need a separately approved ledger debit carried into seed budgets; operator waits excluded, no hidden free rendering.

evaluation.style_target: Historical comparator diagnostic; original FAIL unchanged
evaluation.effect_proof: Remove placement and measure canonical occurrence control-point differences; compare nonidentity scale with scale=1 at exactly the same advance delta
evaluation.owner_test_review: Unseen triple reading and preference against best spacing-only and context-off; no automatic preference score invented

required_before_first_fit: Owner approval of new context geometry/lineage contract and exact variant bounds
Current-source primitive/gesture/fixed-action/letter consumption clearance under explicit approved scope; no old-reader bypass
Null context exact replay and mechanical variant envelope proofs
Owner training judgments and deterministic objective/tie-breaking fully frozen
